title: 第十一章 去警局谈谈
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张总和大强两人一阵心慌。

人在做坏事的时候，总是提心吊胆。

更别说他们做的还不是普通的坏事，运渣车里放着一个骷髅架子，要是被发现了，顺带着牵扯出来十几年前的事，那他们可就完了。

没有丝毫犹豫，张总直接从运渣车里跑了下来，跑到门卫面前，快速道：

“大哥，这是怎么回事，好端端的怎么突然关校门了。”

“我们这边运点废渣出去，麻烦你行行好。”

说着一个红包从包里拿出来，就要往门卫手里放。

“不要答应他。”

“他们是杀人凶手，现在是在转移罪证。”

千钧一发之间

黎雾的声音响起，打断了张总的套近乎。

门卫本来准备拿红包的手顿时就僵硬停在半空之中。

张总和大强两人气愤扭头，看到的就是站在不远处的黎雾。

担心陆云铮那边不能及时通知门卫把校门关上，一番犹豫之下，黎雾还是从教室里给直接跑了出来。

此时看到张总给门卫递红包的动作，顿时长长的舒了一口气。

幸好自己来得及时，给阻止了这一切。

但是下一秒

黎雾的神色僵住了。

张总和大强两人就像是找到了出气口的模样，一脸凶狠的朝黎雾走来。

“*的，死崽子，居然敢坏我的好事。”

“大强，”张总知道今天怕是难善了了，眼中满是狠意，命令道：

“你去开车，直接撞开大门。”

“这狗崽子我慢慢收拾。”

这就是要制造混乱，先让大强跑出去把罪证给清理掉了。

大强没有犹豫，直接跳上运渣车。

轰鸣声响起，一脚油门，运渣车直直的朝学校大门口的方向撞去。

门卫早就被吓得直接躲进了门卫室，缩在角落里快速报警。

张总阴着一张脸，直直朝黎雾的方向跑去：

“*的，敢坏我的事。”

“我看你是活够了。”

“说，你今天还看到了什么？”

黎雾不是傻子，看张总面色不对朝自己走来的第一时间，就转身快速朝着其他地方跑去。

奈何她作为社恐，平日里疏于锻炼。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Mr. Zhang and Daqiang were flustered.

People are always on tenterhooks when they do bad things.

Not to mention that what they did was not an ordinary bad thing. There was a skeleton in the slag truck. If it was discovered and it was implicated in what happened more than ten years ago, then they would be finished.

Without any hesitation, Mr. Zhang ran directly out of the slag truck, ran to the guard, and said quickly:

"Brother, what's going on? Why did the school suddenly close after it was so good?"

"Let's transport some waste out here, please do your best."

As he said this, he took out a red envelope from the bag and put it in the guard's hand.

"Don't promise him."

"They are murderers and now they are transferring evidence."

In the nick of time

Li Wu's voice sounded, interrupting Mr. Zhang's approach.

The guard's hand that was about to take the red envelope suddenly stopped stiff in mid-air.

Mr. Zhang and Daqiang turned their heads angrily and saw Li Wu standing not far away.

Worried that Lu Yunzheng would not be able to notify the guard in time to close the school gate, after some hesitation, Li Wu ran out of the classroom.

At this time, when he saw Mr. Zhang handing the red envelope to the doorman, he let out a long sigh of relief.

Fortunately, I arrived in time and stopped all this.

But the next second

Li Wu's expression froze.

Mr. Zhang and Daqiang seemed to have found an outlet and walked towards Li Wu with fierce expressions.

"You damn bastard, how dare you ruin my good deeds."

"Daqiang," Mr. Zhang knew that it would be difficult to be kind today, and his eyes were full of cruelty as he ordered:

"Go ahead and drive the car and open the gate."

"I'll deal with this bitch slowly."

This is to create chaos and let Daqiang run out first to clear away the evidence.

Daqiang didn't hesitate and jumped directly onto the slag truck.

There was a roar, and with a kick of the accelerator, the slag truck crashed straight towards the school gate.

The guard was so frightened that he hid in the guard room, huddled in the corner and quickly called the police.

Mr. Zhang had a gloomy face and ran straight in the direction of Li Wu:

"You dare to ruin my business."

"I think you've had enough."

"Tell me, what else did you see today?"

Li Wu was not a fool. As soon as he saw Mr. Zhang walking towards him with a strange look on his face, he turned around and ran quickly to other places.

However, as a social worker, she neglects to exercise on weekdays.
